g.text: CATAN MULTIPLAYER — 3D GRAPHICAL ASSETS & VISUAL SYSTEM
Figma Asset Library • Isometric 3D Hex Biomes, Hand-Carved Wooden Pieces, 3D Tumbling Dice, & Illustrated Card Trays
Each biome is an extruded 3D hexagonal pedestal with beveled stone base, atmospheric lighting, and high-detail terrain props.
Crafted with top specular bevels, side grain shadows, and ground drop shadows in 6 player colors.
3. ILLUSTRATED CARD TRAYS & TACTILE HUD COCKPIT
Parchment deck cards, floating player hand drawer, and glassmorphic cockpit dock.
